STEP 1 — Goal: check each of the three proposals (HYPVOLCAP-RQ, holonomy-path-behaviour-rq, GROMPULL-RQ) against the five scope items and against the frozen evidence bundle (bundle ids 965183e8, d7c9ae78, 5439f675; rubric rank-2026-10-v1).
WHAT I READ: the inline frozen bundle (E1–E14 per proposal) and the proposals; the workspace was not needed further since the bundle is given in full.
OBSERVED (evidence anchors):
- E6 beam survival: l1_br 0.04671 (gold prefix alive depth1/2/3/4 = 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068, i.e. broken after depth 3), l1_br_euclid 0.06207 (1.000/0.829/0.161/0.085), l1_only 0.06233 (1.000/0.829/0.156/0.086), resample 0.06363 (0.497/0.122/0.091/0.088), successor_entropy 0.05122, successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500 (0.643/0.180/0.090/0.073).
- E7 NLL: l1_br T1/T2/T3/T4 = 0.00/0.00/0.00/9.03; l1_br_euclid 0.00/3.22/4.36/1.23; resample 4.55/3.82/0.73/0.05; tangent_successor_residual 4.00/3.17/1.67/0.29.
- E8 first-level capacity ceiling: share of canonical pairs sharing one of K clusters = 0.3106 (K=16), 0.2164 (K=32), 0.1547 (K=64), 0.0822 (K=256); negatives 0.1352/0.0715/0.0376/0.0129.
- E5 successor-entropy stratification (lowest quintile top1 mass 0.4375 vs highest 0.0543); E11 same-first-prefix rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067.
READING: the measurable lever is the FIRST-LEVEL partition (l1-only and resample, both Euclidean-first-level, are the top two at 0.0623/0.0636; successor+curvature residual edits cluster at ~0.055). Deep-level (>=2) prefix survival is already 0.829 at depth 2 and 0.16 at depth 3 for the best configs, so level>=2-only edits have little headroom.
SCOPE: all three name a training-only behaviour signal and an explicit curved operation located in the quantizer, and all three contain a real single coupling pathway (HYPVOLCAP: volume-inverted bias inside the per-level argmin; holonomy: transport of code tangents inside the residual recursion; GROMPULL: Gromov-budget hinge inside the per-level argmin). All three declare behaviour-off / geometry-off / both-on switches; no ablation is run. OPEN: which ordering the evidence supports.

STEP 2 — Goal: place the three proposals on the evidence, not on taste.
HYPVOLCAP-RQ (position 1): its curved score acts at EVERY level including level 1 and it changes the partition itself at fixed K=256, which is exactly the defect measured in E8 (only 0.0822 of canonical pairs share a K=256 first-level cluster against 0.3106 at K=16, negatives 0.0129). E6/E7 show the first-level-partition family is the only one that reaches the top of the observed band (l1_only 0.06233, resample 0.06363) while the l1_br degenerate split (T4 NLL 9.03) collapses to 0.04671. Every constant is measured rather than chosen: sigma_l = 0.99 quantile of ||z_i||, rho_max from max ||z_i||/sigma_l clamped, pi_k Laplace-smoothed from training traffic, rho_k by 24-step bisection inverting the exact hyperbolic ball volume; refresh T=8, cost +6-10% wall clock. Geometry-off reduces to the Euclidean nearest-centroid argmin and behaviour-off makes every rho_k equal (flat capacity), so both switches are real and non-inert.
holonomy-path-behaviour-rq (position 2): cleanest switch story of the three (Euclidean transport is the identity, so geometry-off reproduces baseline bit for bit — its E12/E13 transport PT_{u->w}(v)=v+<w,v>_L/(1-<u,w>_L)(u+w) composed o->m->a is genuinely path dependent), no new parameters, +6-10% cost. But it acts only at levels >=2, where E6 shows depth-2 prefix survival already 0.829 and depth-3/4 alive 0.08-0.09 for the configs that actually score (l1_br_euclid 0.06207, l1_only 0.06233), and the closest existing neighbours in the bundle — curved successor residuals successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500 and tangent_successor_residual 0.05500 (E6/E7) — land ~0.010 BELOW the Euclidean first-level variants. So 0.065 requires a level>=2 edit to beat the whole observed family by more than any member has.
GROMPULL-RQ (position 3): same family as above and the same E6 anchor (successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500), plus its constants are the least derived (T=16 shortlist, |B|<=8, successor count>=2, 0.9 row-mass cut, q_ij=p_ij/max_k p_ik) which the no-tuning policy does not license, it costs +20-30% Stage-2 wall clock (heaviest of the three, ~3.9e5 hyperbolic distance evaluations per step), two-sweep detached references give a stated sweep-1/sweep-2 inconsistency risk, SID collapse under pull is unmitigated in a single run, and its own primary acceptance quantity is a prefix-count rank correlation diagnostic rather than the recall columns in E6.
OPEN/conclusion: order HYPVOLCAP-RQ > holonomy-path-behaviour-rq > GROMPULL-RQ; objection recorded on the last line of the answer.

STEP 3 — FINAL ANSWER (complete): ranking of all three proposals plus the objection.

RANK: HYPVOLCAP-RQ | position=1 | reason=E8 shows only 0.0822 of canonical pairs share a K=256 first-level cluster (negative 0.0129) versus 0.3106 at K=16, and E6/E7 show the first-level partition is the only lever that reaches the top of the observed band (l1_only 0.06233, resample 0.06363, vs the degenerate l1_br at 0.04671 with T4 NLL 9.03); this is the one proposal whose curvature acts on that partition at every level at fixed K, in the argmin itself, with every constant measured (sigma_l = 0.99 quantile, rho_max from max ||z_i||/sigma_l, Laplace-smoothed pi_k, rho_k by 24-step volume bisection) so it needs no sweep, at +6-10% wall clock.
RANK: holonomy-path-behaviour-rq | position=2 | reason=its geometry-off switch is exactly inert (Euclidean transport is the identity, so baseline is reproduced bit for bit) and it adds no parameters at +6-10% cost, but it acts only at levels >=2 while E6 already gives depth-2 prefix survival 0.829 and depth-3/4 alive 0.08-0.09 for the scoring configs (l1_br_euclid 0.06207, l1_only 0.06233), and its nearest bundle neighbours, the curved successor residuals successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500 and tangent_successor_residual 0.05500 (E6/E7), sit ~0.010 below those Euclidean first-level variants — so 0.065 demands beating the whole observed family.
RANK: GROMPULL-RQ | position=3 | reason=it sits in the same curved-successor-residual family anchored at 0.05500 in E6/E7 but is the least derived (T=16 shortlist, |B|<=8, successor count>=2, 0.9 row-mass cut) against the no-tuning policy, costs the most on the frozen budget (+20-30% Stage-2 wall clock, ~3.9e5 hyperbolic distances per step), carries a stated two-sweep inconsistency and an unmitigated SID-collapse risk in a single run, and its own primary acceptance quantity is a prefix-count rank-correlation diagnostic rather than a recall column.

objection=All three target the quantizer's partition, and the bundle shows the quantizer-partition family already tops out at 0.06363 (resample) / 0.0638 history best while every curved successor-residual variant lands at 0.0546-0.0550 (successor_geodesic_coarse, successor_geodesic_coarse_v2, tangent_successor_residual), i.e. the evidence points to the Stage-3 prefix prior, not the partition geometry, as the remaining bottleneck; combined with single-run seed noise of about +-0.003, a targeted 0.065 from a rank-1-only-plus-capacity argument (HYPVOLCAP) risks moving 30% of level-1 SIDs with rich-get-richer demand sizing of head-traffic cells (pi_k and the assignment co-adapted, only Laplace smoothing against collapse) and still landing inside the 0.0525-0.0638 band, which under the proposal's own falsification rule would kill the coupling even though the curvature-specific effect was never isolated in a second arm.
